integrity: Mathematical proof and standard-library numerical reproduction are supplied. Numerical checks are not substitutes for proof; no independent external audit or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: The deterministic well-mixed Allee model assumes 0<A<1, 0<c<d<(1-A)^2/(4A), T>0 and 0<w<=1. Fold boundaries, stochasticity, spatial and delayed effects, and nonautonomous parameters are not covered. Unindexed literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp greed-dependent extinction boundary in an Allee common-pool game
